# Homelab

This repository contains Infrastructure as Code (IaC) configurations for my homelab using CUE as the primary configuration language.

## Components

| Component | Source |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| [Caddy](https://caddyserver.com) | `main.cue` |
| [icloudpd](https://github.com/boredazfcuk/icloudpd) | `main.cue` |
| [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) | `main.cue` |
| [obsidian-sync](https://github.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync) | `main.cue` |
| [Pihole](https://pi-hole.net) | `main.cue` |
| [SABnzbd](https://sabnzbd.org) | `main.cue` |
| [Speedtest tracker](https://github.com/alexjustesen/speedtest-tracker) | `main.cue` |
| [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) | `main.cue` |
| [Uptime Kuma](https://uptime.kuma.pet) | `main.cue` |

## Structure

```
├── cue.mod/                 # CUE modules and dependencies
├── main.cue                 # Main entry point for homelab configurations
├── terraform/               # Terraform configurations (DNS/Cloudflare)
├── secrets.enc.yaml         # Encrypted secrets (SOPS)
└── justfile                 # Automation commands via just
```

## Usage

### Prerequisites

- [just](https://github.com/casey/just) - Command runner
- [CUE](https://cuelang.org) - Configuration language
- [Ansible](https://ansible.com) - Configuration management
- [SOPS](https://github.com/mozilla/sops) - Secret management
- [Terraform](https://terraform.io) - Infrastructure provisioning
- [age](https://github.com/FiloSottile/age) - Encryption

### Deploy Services

```bash
# Deploy Docker services via Ansible
just deploy

# Generate docker-compose.yml from CUE
just gen

# Plan Terraform changes
just tf plan

# Apply Terraform changes
just tf apply
```

### Secret Management

```bash
# Decrypt secrets
just secrets decrypt

# Edit secrets
just secrets edit

# Encrypt secrets
just secrets encrypt
```

package homelab

import (
	"encoding/yaml"
	"tool/cli"
)

// Docker Compose schema
#ComposeFile: {
	services: [string]: #Service
	networks?: [string]: #Network
	volumes?: [string]: #Volume
}

#Service: {
	image:           string
	container_name?: string
	restart?:        string
	ports?: [...string]
	volumes?: [...string]
	environment?: [string]: string | number | bool
	env_file?: [...string]
	depends_on?: [...string]
	networks?: [...string]
	command?: string | [...string]
	labels?: [string]: string
	logging?: {
		driver: string
		options?: [string]: string
	}
	cap_add?: [...string]
	dns?: [...string]
	healthcheck?: {
		test: [...string]
		interval?:     string
		timeout?:      string
		retries?:      int
		start_period?: string
	}
	devices?: [...string]
}

#Network: {
	driver?: string
	external?: bool
}

#Volume: {
	driver?: string
	external?: bool
}

// Caddy with Cloudflare DNS
caddy: #Service & {
	image:          "ghcr.io/rami3l/homelab-caddy:latest"
	container_name: "caddy"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"80:80",
		"443:443",
		"443:443/udp",
	]
	volumes: [
		"/opt/homelab/caddy/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro",
		"caddy_data:/data",
		"caddy_config:/config",
	]
	env_file: [".env"]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Tailscale sidecar for homelab networking
tailscale: #Service & {
	image:          "tailscale/tailscale:stable"
	container_name: "tailscale"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	environment: {
		TS_AUTHKEY:            "${TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY}"
		TS_HOSTNAME:           "nuc"
		TS_STATE_DIR:          "/var/lib/tailscale"
		TS_EXTRA_ARGS:         "--advertise-exit-node --accept-routes"
	}
	cap_add: ["NET_ADMIN", "NET_RAW"]
	volumes: [
		"tailscale_state:/var/lib/tailscale",
		"/dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Pi-hole DNS
pihole: #Service & {
	image:          "pihole/pihole:latest"
	container_name: "pihole"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"53:53/tcp",
		"53:53/udp",
		"8080:80/tcp",
	]
	environment: {
		TZ:            "America/New_York"
		WEBPASSWORD:   "${PIHOLE_PASSWORD}"
		FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode: "all"
	}
	volumes: [
		"pihole_data:/etc/pihole",
		"pihole_dnsmasq:/etc/dnsmasq.d",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// SABnzbd - Usenet downloader
sabnzbd: #Service & {
	image:          "lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:latest"
	container_name: "sabnzbd"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"8081:8080",
	]
	environment: {
		PUID: 1000
		PGID: 1000
		TZ:   "America/New_York"
	}
	volumes: [
		"sabnzbd_config:/config",
		"/opt/homelab/downloads:/downloads",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Uptime Kuma - Self-hosted monitoring
uptimeKuma: #Service & {
	image:          "louislam/uptime-kuma:1"
	container_name: "uptime-kuma"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"3001:3001",
	]
	volumes: [
		"uptime_kuma_data:/app/data",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Speedtest Tracker - Monitor internet speeds
speedtestTracker: #Service & {
	image:          "lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest"
	container_name: "speedtest-tracker"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"8082:80",
	]
	environment: {
		PUID:            1000
		PGID:            1000
		TZ:              "America/New_York"
		APP_KEY:         "${SPEEDTEST_APP_KEY}"
		SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE: "0 */4 * * *"
		PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN: 365
		DB_CONNECTION:   "sqlite"
	}
	volumes: [
		"speedtest_data:/config",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// ntfy - Push notifications
ntfy: #Service & {
	image:          "binwiederhier/ntfy:latest"
	container_name: "ntfy"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"2586:80",
	]
	environment: {
		TZ:               "America/New_York"
		NTFY_BASE_URL:    "https://ntfy.rmb.sh"
		NTFY_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL: "https://ntfy.sh"
	}
	volumes: [
		"ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy",
		"ntfy_data:/etc/ntfy",
	]
	command: "serve"
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// icloudpd - iCloud Photo Downloader
icloudpd: #Service & {
	image:          "boredazfcuk/icloudpd:latest"
	container_name: "icloudpd"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	environment: {
		TZ:                       "America/New_York"
		apple_id:                 "${APPLE_ID}"
		download_path:            "/home/rambhia/icloud"
		notification_type:        "Ntfy"
		ntfy_server:              "https://ntfy.rmb.sh"
		ntfy_topic:               "${NTFY_TOPIC}"
		authentication_type:      "MFA"
		synchronisation_interval: 43200
		user:                     "rambhia"
		user_id:                  1000
		group:                    "rambhia"
		group_id:                 1000
	}
	volumes: [
		"icloudpd_config:/config",
		"/home/rambhia/icloud:/home/rambhia/icloud",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Obsidian LiveSync - Self-hosted sync for Obsidian
obsidianSync: #Service & {
	image:          "couchdb:latest"
	container_name: "obsidian-sync"
	restart:        "unless-stopped"
	ports: [
		"5984:5984",
	]
	environment: {
		COUCHDB_USER:     "${COUCHDB_USER}"
		COUCHDB_PASSWORD: "${COUCHDB_PASSWORD}"
	}
	volumes: [
		"obsidian_sync_data:/opt/couchdb/data",
		"/opt/homelab/obsidian-sync/local.ini:/opt/couchdb/etc/local.ini:ro",
	]
	networks: ["homelab"]
}

// Compose file output
compose: #ComposeFile & {
	services: {
		"caddy":             caddy
		"tailscale":         tailscale
		"pihole":            pihole
		"sabnzbd":           sabnzbd
		"uptime-kuma":       uptimeKuma
		"speedtest-tracker": speedtestTracker
		"ntfy":              ntfy
		"icloudpd":          icloudpd
		"obsidian-sync":     obsidianSync
	}
	networks: {
		homelab: driver: "bridge"
	}
	volumes: {
		caddy_data: {}
		caddy_config: {}
		tailscale_state: {}
		pihole_data: {}
		pihole_dnsmasq: {}
		sabnzbd_config: {}
		uptime_kuma_data: {}
		speedtest_data: {}
		ntfy_cache: {}
		ntfy_data: {}
		icloudpd_config: {}
		obsidian_sync_data: {}
	}
}

// Command to generate docker-compose.yml
command: gen: {
	print: cli.Print & {
		text: yaml.Marshal(compose)
	}
}

</result>

# Default recipe to list all recipes
default:
    @just --list

# Generate docker-compose.yml from CUE
gen:
    cue cmd gen > docker-compose.yml

# Validate CUE configuration
validate:
    cue vet main.cue

# Deploy using Ansible
deploy:
    ansible-playbook -i inventory.yml playbook.yml

# SSH into homelab server
ssh:
    ssh homelab

# Show generated compose without saving
show:
    cue cmd gen

# Format all CUE files
fmt:
    cue fmt *.cue

# Terraform commands
tf *ARGS:
    cd terraform && terraform {{ARGS}}

# Secret management commands
secrets action:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    case "{{action}}" in
        decrypt)
            sops -d secrets.enc.yaml > secrets.yaml
            ;;
        edit)
            sops secrets.enc.yaml
            ;;
        encrypt)
            sops -e secrets.yaml > secrets.enc.yaml
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown action: {{action}}"
            echo "Available actions: decrypt, edit, encrypt"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac

</result>

# Cloudflare DNS configuration

locals {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  homelab_ip = var.homelab_tailscale_ip

  # Services exposed via Caddy reverse proxy
  services = toset([
    "pihole",
    "sabnzbd",
    "uptime",
    "speedtest",
    "ntfy",
    "obsidian",
  ])
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "homelab_services" {
  for_each = local.services

  zone_id = local.zone_id
  name    = each.key
  content = local.homelab_ip
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 1  # Auto TTL
  proxied = false
}

# Root domain record
resource "cloudflare_record" "root" {
  zone_id = local.zone_id
  name    = "@"
  content = local.homelab_ip
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 1
  proxied = false
}

# www redirect
resource "cloudflare_record" "www" {
  zone_id = local.zone_id
  name    = "www"
  content = local.homelab_ip
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 1
  proxied = false
}

## Codebase Overview

This is a **homelab Infrastructure as Code (IaC) repository** that manages a personal home server setup. Here's the architecture:

### Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|-------|------------|---------|
| Configuration | **CUE** | Type-safe Docker Compose generation |
| Deployment | **Ansible** | Configuration management and deployment |
| Infrastructure | **Terraform** | Cloudflare DNS record management |
| Secrets | **SOPS + age** | Encrypted secret storage |
| Task Runner | **just** | Command automation |

### Services Managed

The `main.cue` file defines Docker services:
- **Caddy** - Reverse proxy with Cloudflare DNS integration
- **Tailscale** - VPN/mesh networking (exit node)
- **Pi-hole** - DNS-level ad blocking
- **SABnzbd** - Usenet downloader
- **Uptime Kuma** - Service monitoring
- **Speedtest Tracker** - Internet speed monitoring
- **ntfy** - Push notification server
- **icloudpd** - iCloud photo downloader
- **Obsidian Sync** - CouchDB-based Obsidian note sync

### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/homelab/main.cue` | Core service definitions with CUE schemas |
| `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/homelab/justfile` | Task automation (deploy, gen, secrets, tf) |
| `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/homelab/terraform/cloudflare.tf` | DNS records for services |
| `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/homelab/secrets.enc.yaml` | SOPS-encrypted secrets |

### Workflow

1. Define services in `main.cue` using typed CUE schemas
2. Run `just gen` to output `docker-compose.yml`
3. Run `just deploy` to apply via Ansible
4. DNS records managed separately via `just tf apply`

The repository follows a clean separation of concerns with CUE providing type safety for Docker configurations, Terraform handling external infrastructure, and Ansible orchestrating deployment.
